candidates.title: Lunar Receiving Laboratory (LRL) - Slezak, Terry - Moon Dust - MSC
candidates.description: The first direct exposure to Lunar material for Crew Reception Personnel probably happened late Friday, 07/25/1969. Terry Slezak (displaying Moon dust on his left hand fingers), MSC photographic technician, was removing film magazines from the first of two (2) containers when the incident occurred.
